subject: Request: temporary quota bump & pricing bundle options
messages:
From: Maya Rodriguez <maya@fastretail.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: short-term quota bump for Black Friday test

Hi Ben,

Quick one — we have a scheduled performance test next week (Black Friday sim) and our telemetry suggests we will exceed the current quota mid-day. Can you temporarily increase our token quota/rate limit for Nov 7-9? This is strictly a short window; we expect baseline usage to resume after the test.

Also, procurement asked whether there is a bundled prepay option that would give us a discount if we commit to some burst credit now. They need numbers by Wednesday to route PO.

Attaching the test plan from our side (not attached here — will send if helpful). Can you advise: 1) best short-term lift option, 2) a pricing example with and without a prepay bundle, and 3) any lead time for enabling?

Thanks — Maya
Maya Rodriguez
Head of Platform & Ops, FastRetail
maya@fastretail.com

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Rodriguez <maya@fastretail.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term quota bump for Black Friday test

Hi Maya — thanks for the heads up. We can do a temporary lift and I can outline two pragmatic options quickly: 

1) Episodic Headroom (fast enable): +30% throughput and a soft rate-limit increase for the 72-hour window. No contract change; invoiced as overrun at standard overage rates. Lead time: minutes to hours once approved (we'll provision the pool).

2) Prepay Burst Bundle (preferred for cost): You prepay a fixed amount of burst credits (e.g., $25k) that we apply during the window. That converts overruns to prepaid consumption at a discounted unit rate (we can offer 18% off list for this short bundle). Requires a PO and signature; we can provision same day after receipt.

Quick numbers (illustrative):
- Estimated excess tokens for test: ~45M tokens
- Overrun rate (standard): $0.00030/token -> ~$13,500
- Prepay bundle: $25,000 for up to 80M tokens effective (~$0.000156/token with 18% discount vs list)

If procurement needs lower headline spend, we can structure a smaller prepay (e.g., $15k) with a slightly smaller discount. I can loop in legal if you need contract language.

Next steps: tell me which option FastRetail prefers and I’ll get Jordan to finalize the commercial doc and Markus to confirm escalation/credit approvals.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Maya Rodriguez <maya@fastretail.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: FastRetail Procurement <procurement@fastretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term quota bump for Black Friday test

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear options. Procurement has a few asks before they can issue a PO: 

- Can you move the discount to 22% if we commit to a $30k prepaid bundle?
- Will the prepaid credits roll into monthly consumption if not fully used during the window? (they prefer not to lose spend)
- Can you provide a short SOW that says Redwood will guarantee provisioning within 8 hours of PO receipt for this window?

If we can get those three items confirmed, procurement will try to get us a PO by EOD Wednesday.

On point 2 above, if credits can roll, that actually makes a $30k commitment easier to justify.

Best,
Maya

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Rodriguez <maya@fastretail.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term quota bump for Black Friday test

> Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear options. Procurement has a few asks before they can issue a PO: 
> 
> - Can you move the discount to 22% if we commit to a $30k prepaid bundle?
> - Will the prepaid credits roll into monthly consumption if not fully used during the window? (they prefer not to lose spend)
> - Can you provide a short SOW that says Redwood will guarantee provisioning within 8 hours of PO receipt for this window?
> 
> If we can get those three items confirmed, procurement will try to get us a PO by EOD Wednesday.
> 
> On point 2 above, if credits can roll, that actually makes a $30k commitment easier to justify.

Hi Maya — looping in Jordan and Markus to confirm approvals and SOW language. Quick answers from our side: 

- Discount: We can stretch to 22% on a $30k prepaid burst credit for a one-time, short-window allowance (this is an exception we can approve for strategic customers).
- Credit roll: Prepaid burst credits will roll for up to 90 days post-window to cover follow-up testing/launch consumption; after 90 days remaining credits convert to platform credits at the discounted rate and can be applied to future invoices (we'll reflect this in the SOW).
- SOW & provisioning SLA: Markus has drafted a short SOW clause that commits to provisioning within 8 hours (subject to normal maintenance blackout windows). I'll attach the SOW and a provisional invoice for $30k for procurement to route.

Attachments: SOW_tempo_lift_v1.docx, provisional_topup_invoice.pdf

Jordan / Markus — please confirm legal signoff and whether we need an exec approval for the 22% exception so I can tell Maya the required internal approvers and ETA.

Thanks,
Ben

From: FastRetail Procurement <procurement@fastretail.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Please confirm once provisioning is scheduled (we will send the PO via our portal later today). We expect provisioning no later than Nov 6 to allow internal QA on Nov 7.
